learningGoals: Identify common farm animals and their adorable babies. 🐄🐥
Recognize and playfully imitate the sounds that farm animals make. 🦆🎶
Appreciate nature and understand what life is like on a busy farm. 🌳☀️
Improve speaking skills by repeating simple words and animal sounds. 🗣️🌟
teachingTips: Read the chapter aloud with enthusiasm and make funny animal noises to bring the story to life! 🎭✨
Show your little one pictures or safe videos of real farm animals so they can connect the book to the real world. 🌍📱
Encourage your child to point at the colourful pictures in the Mridang textbook and name the animals they see. 📖👆
Praise their efforts with lots of claps and high-fives when they successfully guess an animal or its sound! 👏💖

funActivities.title: Animal Sound Charades 🎭🐮
funActivities.description: Take turns acting out a farm animal and making its sound while the other person guesses which animal it is. It is a fantastic way to laugh and learn together!

funActivities.title: Little Farmer Art Time 🖍️🎨
funActivities.description: Give your child a blank sheet of paper and some crayons. Ask them to draw their very own colourful farm featuring their favorite animals from the chapter.

funActivities.title: Sing-Along Farm Party 🎶🎸
funActivities.description: Sing classic rhymes like Old MacDonald Had a Farm and encourage your child to insert the names and sounds of the animals they just learned.
